$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the New Tab page's widgets; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: newTabWidgets
lists.note: The Minimal New Tab layout's widgets (Leo 2026-10-20: "only do the composer for the default"): Minimal, the default tabs.newTabTemplate, is the composer; each part around it is a widget, off by default. The other layouts draw what they always drew. The app sends the ones on as the page's pageWidgets (webviews newtab/pageWidgets.ts).

rows.note: Off by default (Leo 2026-10-22: "new tab page let's have no greeting text by default... maybe as toggle but as useful toggle"). On: a headline over the composer that asks "What should we work on in <project>?" with the project as an inline picker, never a time-of-day greeting. The key keeps its old name, so a saved true turns the headline on.

title.text: Ask What to Work On on New Tab

help.text: A headline over the composer that asks what to work on, with the project as a picker.

rows.note: Off by default. On: Default's card of this Mac and its recent projects, with the page in Default's stage. The composer's project strip picks a folder either way.

help.text: A card of this Mac and its recent projects over the composer.

rows.note: Off by default. On: the chats that need you, New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat. The palette and the pane's + menu have them either way.

title.text: Show Quick Actions on New Tab

help.text: Chats that need you, and New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat.

rows.note: Off by default. On: the recent chats as rows under the composer. The palette (Cmd-P) finds a chat either way.

title.text: Show Recent Chats on New Tab

help.text: Your recent chats under the composer. The palette finds any chat.

rows.name: styleDots
rows.note: Off by default. On: the dots under the page that switch its template (tabs.newTabTemplate).

title.text: Show Template Dots on New Tab

help.text: Dots under the page that switch its template.

rows.note: Off by default. On: the current conditions and today's high and low beside the composer, from Open-Meteo (no key). The place is tabs.newTabWidgets.weatherCity, else the city of this Mac's time zone, so it needs no location permission. Nothing is fetched while it is off. Cached 30 minutes; offline shows the last reading dimmed.

help.text: The current weather and today's high and low, for the city below or your time zone's city.

rows.note: Empty uses the city of this Mac's time zone. A city name ("Berlin", "San Francisco") is looked up with Open-Meteo's geocoding.

help.text: A city for the weather widget. Empty uses your time zone's city.

rows.note: Off by default. On: each machine the composer can start a chat on (this Mac, SSH and cloud peers) with its color, its icon and whether it is online.

help.text: Your machines and whether each is online.

rows.name: clock
rows.note: Off by default. On: a quiet local time display beside the composer.

help.text: A quiet local time display beside the composer.

rows.name: timer
rows.note: Off by default. On: a small elapsed-time stopwatch beside the composer.

help.text: A small elapsed-time stopwatch beside the composer.

rows.name: warmGreeting
rows.note: Off by default. On: a time-of-day greeting such as Good afternoon.

title.text: Show Warm Greeting on New Tab

help.text: A time-of-day greeting such as Good afternoon.

rows.name: quote
rows.note: Off by default. On: a bundled public-domain quote, changing daily.

title.text: Show Quote of the Day on New Tab

help.text: A bundled public-domain quote, changing daily.
